name: Samaritan House
items: Children’s clothing and toiletries; arrange a drop-off appointment first.
notes: Contact the organization before bringing goods. Check its current accepted-item list.

name: San Mateo Main Library — Friends book donations
items: Clean, new or gently used books and DVDs/Blu-rays.
notes: Main Library lobby during library hours. Up to two boxes or four bags; arrange larger donations in advance.

name: Second Harvest — Bing Center
items: Unopened, unexpired shelf-stable food. No glass containers or prepared food.
notes: Check current drop-off hours before visiting. Contact Second Harvest before organizing a collection for them.
